This procedure details 
 the testing procedures 
 P1, which recommended to be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 
 in the title block.

The purpose of the relay is 
 basically to give an indication that an inter turn fault occur to earth in the 
 stator winding or turn-to-turn fault which give trip.

The relay contains over 
 current relay set at 2.5%amp, timer operates at half-second-delay time, 
 voltage transformer supplied with 110Vac from the voltage transformer of the 
 stator winding as the generator operate and 100V from the testing transformer 
 when the unit off, an resistance which convert the voltage to current. When 
 the fault occur the over current will give trip signal after half second 
 delay

The first draft initiated by eng. Baha Salah Farag, tested by eng. Badry Atea 
 Rofaiel, 
 accepted by eng. Abdel Azem Gomaa Hagrasy, certified by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: UEEPC quality control head sector & MPIS 
 coordinator, and approved by eng. Hussein Ahmed Mahdy: head sector of Assiut 
 Steam PS.

A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc

 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc
The line is out of service
Isolate the relay from PT`s & CT`s
Test transformer to give the test voltage (7v).

Selector switch to get the 
 test voltage from the test transformer to the relay and isolate the voltage 
 coming from the main unit transformer.

Turn the supply voltage 
 switch from the off position to the auxiliary voltage position.

Insert the special test key 
 into the test selector switch (b2).

Change the position of the 
 test selector switch by the test key on the test panel to the test delay 
 action position.

Press on the test key button 
 until the signal appears.

Release the button of the 
 test key and return the selector back to its first position (action).

Return the supply voltage 
 selector switch back to its off position.

Reset the stator earth 
 leakage relay to its normal position.

Record the values (results) 
 on the test sheet.
